name: KubeVirt Self-Hosted Virtual Machines
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 Kubernetes virtualization API and runtime to create and manage virtual machines within your own Kubernetes cluster, without per-VM software usage fees.
watch_out: KubeVirt is a self-hosted VM orchestration component, NOT a free public VPS or a hosted cloud allocation. Requires an operational Kubernetes cluster, virtualization-capable nodes, storage, networking and platform expertise; those costs remain yours.
